label: Tower
subject: tower
title: THE TOWER THAT LISTENS
subtitle: Every tower claims to be the first. This one does not bother. It simply leans into the sky and listens. Those who sleep in its halls wake changed.

sections.heading: A PLACE OUTSIDE MAPS
body: Every tower claims to be the first. This one does not bother. It has watched too many calendars burn to care about being oldest.
The tower stands where roads forget their names. Travelers arrive by accident as often as by intention. The stones remember every step more clearly than the world remembers the paths that led here.

sections.heading: HOW THE TOWER LISTENS
body: It listens with brick and window, with stair and door. The creak you hear at midnight is not age; it is attention.
When apprentices argue in whispers, their words drift into the mortar. When a wizard traces a new sigil on the floor, the tower copies it, line by invisible line, deep into its foundations.
This is why spells cast here behave differently once taken into the wider world. The tower has been correcting them under its breath.

sections.heading: ROOMS AS ORGANS
body: The entry hall is a throat that decides who may pass. The library is a lung full of dust and old names. The alchemy lab is a stomach that tries everything once.
Higher still, the observatory is the tower’s single patient eye. It does not close. It only narrows when something in the sky looks back.
Your wizard will think he is walking rooms. In truth, he is walking through the tower’s thoughts about him.

sections.heading: THE PRICE OF SLEEPING HERE
body: Those who sleep in its halls wake changed. Sometimes the change is small: a new scar where no blade ever touched, a word from a forgotten tongue sitting stubbornly on the tip of the tongue.
Sometimes the change is larger. A hand that glows faintly when someone lies. Footsteps that no longer echo, even on bare stone. Dreams that leave chalk circles on the floor.
The tower does not ask permission before it rewrites those who rest under its roof. It assumes that anyone who lies down here already agreed.
